The affix सिच् before आत्मनेपद affixes is कित् after the verb यम् when meaning 'to divulge'.

Terms: कित्

And The affix अप् comes optionally after the verb यम् 'to surround' when the उपसर्ग -s सम् , उप , नि and वि are in composition ; or even when it is without उपसर्ग -less.

Terms: अप्

The सिच् of the Aorist in परस्मैपद takes the augment इट् after the roots 1. यम् 2. रम् 3. नम् and roots ending in the long आ and स् (सक्) is added at the end of these अङ्ग (stems).

Terms: इट् augment
